article_title: Women given free shorts at Oktoberfest to prevent upskirting

tasks.prompt: Why has the Teufelsrad operator been giving free cycling shorts to women and girls?
options: To protect them from voyeuristic filming when their skirts lift on the ride
To help riders stay on the rotating platform longer
To advertise a new sportswear company at Oktoberfest
To replace the traditional dirndl dress
tasks.correct_answer: To protect them from voyeuristic filming when their skirts lift on the ride
tasks.explanation_hebrew: אליזבת פולאצי מחלקת מכנסי רכיבה כדי להגן על נשים ונערות מפני צילום מציצני כשהחצאית מתרוממת בזמן הנסיעה.

tasks.prompt: How many pairs of cycling shorts did Elisabeth Polaczy say she had handed out at this Oktoberfest?
options: Fewer than 20 pairs
Exactly 32 pairs
More than 100 pairs
About 9,000 pairs
tasks.explanation_hebrew: פולאצי אמרה שבאוקטוברפסט הנוכחי חילקה יותר ממאה זוגות.

tasks.prompt: What does “voyeuristic” mean in the article’s description of the videos?
options: Recorded for an official police investigation
Secretly or intrusively focused on people’s intimate exposure
Edited to promote the history of the festival
Filmed only by riders with permission
tasks.correct_answer: Secretly or intrusively focused on people’s intimate exposure
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המילה מתארת צילום פולשני בעל אופי מציצני, המתמקד בחשיפה אינטימית ללא הסכמה.

tasks.prompt: What gap in Germany’s current upskirting law did Josephine Ballon identify?
options: It covers only videos made by professional YouTubers.
It applies only during large public festivals.
It excludes images altered after they are uploaded.
It covers filming under a skirt, but not photographing a skirt that flies up.
tasks.correct_answer: It covers filming under a skirt, but not photographing a skirt that flies up.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בלון הסבירה שהחוק חל כשמצלמים מתחת לחצאית, אך לא כאשר החצאית מתרוממת מעצמה ואז מצלמים.

tasks.prompt: Why are warning posters alone unlikely to stop all the filming, according to Polaczy?
options: The ride operator cannot control everyone using smartphones in the crowd.
The posters are written only in Bavarian dialect.
Police are not permitted to enter the Teufelsrad tent.
Visitors are allowed to film freely without any restrictions.
tasks.correct_answer: The ride operator cannot control everyone using smartphones in the crowd.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: למרות השלטים והכרזות, אי־אפשר לפקח על כל אדם בקהל שמחזיק טלפון חכם.

tasks.prompt: In the article, what does a filming “permit” at Oktoberfest mean?
options: A free pair of cycling shorts
A prison sentence for illegal filming
Official paid authorisation issued by the city
Permission from every person visible in a clip
tasks.correct_answer: Official paid authorisation issued by the city
tasks.explanation_hebrew: עיריית מינכן דורשת מיוצרי תוכן אישור רשמי בתשלום לצילום בפסטיבל.

tasks.prompt: Give two figures that show the scale or profitability of the Teufelsrad videos.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שני נתונים מהכתבה, למשל לפחות 32,000 סרטונים, מיליוני צפיות או הכנסה של 9,000 אירו מסרטון אחד.
expected_points: At least 32,000 Teufelsrad videos were reported to be in circulation.
Some clips received millions of views, or one woman reportedly earned €9,000 from a single clip.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the responses by the ride operator, police and Munich city authorities.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול את חלוקת המכנסיים, קמפיין האזהרה והמעצרים, וכן הגבלת שידורים חיים ודרישת רישיון צילום.
expected_points: The operator distributes free cycling shorts and displays warnings.
Police run an anti-upskirting poster campaign and have made arrests.
Munich bans festival live streams and requires paid filming permits for content creators.

tasks.prompt: Why does the article suggest that technology has made the problem harder to control?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר את זמינות הטלפונים, משקפי המצלמה, הפצה נרחבת ברשת, עריכה דיגיטלית ורווחים כתמריצים.
expected_points: Smartphones and camera glasses make discreet filming easier.
Platforms can spread clips to millions, while digital alteration and revenue increase the harm or incentive.

tasks.prompt: Write a short paragraph arguing which measure in the article is most likely to protect visitors effectively.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לבחור אמצעי מהכתבה, לנמק בעזרת פרט קונקרטי ולהכיר לפחות במגבלה אחת.
expected_points: Identify a specific measure such as shorts, enforcement, stronger law or filming permits.
Use an article detail to explain why it could work.
Acknowledge a limitation such as the difficulty of controlling every smartphone.
